description: This is the main activity source file for an Android application demonstrating a navigation drawer implementation. It manages a DrawerLayout with a list of planets, handles drawer toggle behavior, and loads fragment content based on user selection.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: The central activity managing the navigation drawer, UI updates, and fragment transactions.

classes.name: MainActivity.PlanetFragment
classes.description: A fragment class that displays details of selected planet including image and name.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes drawer layout, list, toggle, and selects default item.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Adjusts menu items visibility depending on drawer state.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles action bar item selections, including toggle and web search.

methods.name: selectItem
methods.description: Replaces the main content with a fragment based on user selection, updates UI.

methods.name: onPostCreate
methods.description: Synchronizes the drawer toggle state after activity restoration.

methods.name: onConfigurationChanged
methods.description: Passes configuration change events to the drawer toggle.
